title: The IBM 1401 mainframe runs "Edith"
summary: CuriousMarc runs the program 'Edith' on a 1959 IBM 1401 mainframe at the Computer History Museum. The program prints a famous line-printer image on the vintage machine. The video is part retro-computing demo and part joke.
why: HN points to it as a fun, well-known example of line-printer art on early IBM hardware, and to the channel for vintage computing history.

quote.text: Marc's videos on restoring some old IBM hardware, that includes a good bit of the history that went into them
